comment: What each device description must select, recorded apart from the compiler and the descriptions: RP2040 and RP2350 from pico-sdk 2.2.0, the STM32H753 from ST's stm32h753xx.h and RM0433, the constrained reference from [1990]. descriptions.py compares every fact of each linked image with these. Under lanes, the same for each lane description, an emulator's map rather than a chip, which the corpus holds its derived profile to (D607, D619).

sources.memory map: https://github.com/raspberrypi/pico-sdk/blob/2.2.0/src/rp2_common/pico_crt0/rp2040/memmap_default.ld, SHA-256 d409afb35ec0a8c3edf5ad6935907cb45f225a3cbdfd4c3b8505a7ed92df28dc: RAM 0x20000000 256k, SCRATCH_X 0x20040000 4k, SCRATCH_Y 0x20041000 4k, the 256-byte .boot2 first in FLASH, then the vectors
sources.second stage: https://github.com/raspberrypi/pico-sdk/blob/2.2.0/src/rp2040/boot_stage2/boot_stage2.ld, SHA-256 bc39ab4a78cf3584c242266ec6bd6ef0400c4d8bcda20ed3211cf96e01107339: the boot ROM loads the stage to the top 256 bytes of SRAM, 0x20041f00, above its stack at 0x20042000, the last 4 bytes the checksum; pad_checksum in the same directory, SHA-256 6d5b37f72bdf9f442b78170f7379ea0fb1c4f87ad4014b5057e6a5d796ac454a, which its CMakeLists.txt, SHA-256 5cdcc9bd3cf04d45641aac34dcc117f5fe1c06f3140502cd19fe9e003ce5365d, runs with -s 0xffffffff, sums the first 252 as descriptions.py's crc32_mpeg2 does; the stage's stores go to XIP_SSI_BASE 0x18000000 (addressmap.h) and PPB_BASE 0xe0000000, VTOR at 0xe000ed08 (m0plus.h); what it stores is read from the fetched boot2_generic_03h.S, not recorded here

sources.memory map: https://github.com/raspberrypi/pico-sdk/blob/2.2.0/src/rp2_common/pico_crt0/rp2350/memmap_default.ld, SHA-256 2349d98352370fc22d84d482e53313300e8a52ea42529eced235fa99c109234f: RAM 0x20000000 512k, SCRATCH_X 0x20080000 4k, SCRATCH_Y 0x20081000 4k, the vectors first in FLASH and the embedded block after them, asserted to end in the first 4096 bytes
sources.interrupts: https://github.com/raspberrypi/pico-sdk/blob/2.2.0/src/rp2350/hardware_regs/include/hardware/regs/intctrl.h, SHA-256 e9c90fb163105a8083578ea1d5430a499eb696a5734e9dbfe3e7c45d303e9b1c: PROC0_IRQ_CTI 40, SPARE_IRQ_5 51, every IRQ of 0 to 51 named
sources.core slots: ARMv8-M Mainline with its Security Extension: MemManage 4, BusFault 5, UsageFault 6, SecureFault 7 and DebugMonitor 12 taken, 8 to 10 and 13 reserved
sources.image block: RP2350 Datasheet release 8, 5.9.5.1, Table 503: the 20-byte minimum Arm IMAGE_DEF; 5.1.5.2, p. 329: the boot ROM searches the first 4 kB of flash; its bytes are compared with the fetched embedded_start_block.inc.S assembled by the pinned GCC with its end block off, not recorded here

sources.memory map: ST's stm32h753xx.h, cmsis-device-h7 commit 81db1ec63cdc191fae1565b772da3ea5aa29a683, SHA-256 4f6def439a9fa94705303fe227d34308048c44bd36263d311aa54cc94f8398f5: D1_AXIFLASH_BASE 0x08000000 to FLASH_END 0x081FFFFF, D1_ITCMRAM_BASE 0 64KB, D1_DTCMRAM_BASE 0x20000000 128KB, D1_AXISRAM_BASE 0x24000000 512KB, D2_AHBSRAM_BASE 0x30000000 288KB as SRAM1 128K, SRAM2 128K and SRAM3 32K, D3_SRAM_BASE 0x38000000 64 KB
sources.interrupts: the same header's IRQn_Type: external interrupts 0 to 149, and RM0433 Rev 9 Table 147, p. 759, which has WWDG1_RST at 143, where the header has none, and the RAMECC interrupt ECC at 145, which the SVD lacks and the policy adds (D560); USART3_IRQn 39
sources.core slots: ARMv7-M: MemManage 4, BusFault 5, UsageFault 6 and DebugMonitor 12 taken, 7 to 10 and 13 reserved

sources.profile: spec.md [1990]: 32 KiB flash at zero, 16 KiB RAM at 0x20000000, the upper 4 KiB the stack, a 48-word table at zero, core slots 4-10 and 12-13 and slots 21 and 42-47 zero

sources.boot: QEMU 10.0.13's mps2-an505, measured with the locked binary: its Cortex-M33 r0p3 resets in Secure state with SAU_CTRL 0, loads SP and PC from VTOR_S 0x10000000, and locks up when the image is linked at 0
sources.memory: the same measurement: SSRAM1 is 4 MiB at 0x10000000, aliased at 0, and SSRAM2 and 3 4 MiB at 0x38000000, aliased at 0x28000000, each readable, writable and executable from Secure state
sources.capacities: the constrained reference's, spec.md [1990], so the lane's limits are the corpus's

sources.machine: QEMU 10.0.13's mps2-an500, measured on the locked binary: a Cortex-M7 r1p2 whose MVFR0 0x10110221 has double precision, VTOR 0, 4 MiB at 0 and 4 MiB at 0x20000000, unmapped space above them reading zero without a fault
